declared_exclusions.reason: This file defines the prohibited claims and must therefore contain them verbatim.
The lint implementation loads the prohibited claims and reports them.
The test fixtures for the lint necessarily contain a prohibited claim.

collection_tool_limit.corrupt_objects_are_left_in_place: A corrupt object still blocks every decision. Collecting it would repair a block nobody has looked at, so it is reported and left where it is.
collection_tool_limit.statement: The owner collection tool reports on the protected exception areas and prepares the owner's command. It never collects from the guarded session: the single writing function refuses before its first write unless the effective user is root, and the owner facing wrapper refuses independently of it.
collection_tool_limit.what_it_does_not_prove: That the session cannot reach the protected areas by other means. The refusal rests on the file ownership and the access control lists of the installation, and on the same boundary as everything else here — an additional interactive owner action. A session that obtains that action is outside this model.

description: Durchsetzungsartefakt zu DEC-068 — Eigentuemergrenzen (docs/governance/decisions/DEC-068-eigentuemergrenzen.md): die eine maschinenlesbare Stelle fuer die Schutz- und Grenzaussagen des Guards. Dokumentation, Handoffs, Gateberichte und CLAUDE.md verwenden diese Semantik; das Gate claim-lint weist staerkere Schutzbehauptungen zurueck.

evidence_use_limit.statement: The protocol is a supporting signal. A security or gate statement must additionally rest on reproducible active tests, hash binding, file permissions and independent evidence. A forward appended entry never overrides or weakens a historical acceptance.

mitigation.note: R4 removes the most likely cause. It does not remove the property itself: any unusable configuration still blocks, and that is intended.
mitigation.statement: Normative Quelle: DEC-059 — Schema vor Daten (docs/governance/decisions/DEC-059-schema-vor-daten.md); vollstaendige Bindungsregel dort. Durchsetzung ueber config/governance/config-loaders.json.

observed.recovery: owner action: restore the configuration file from the committed state
observed.trigger: A new field was written into the rule configuration before its loader accepted the field. The loader rejects unknown fields, so the repository side guard could not build a decision.

fail_closed_operating_property.reason_not_a_defect: Blocking on an unusable rule set is the intended reading of fail closed. The alternative — deciding while the rule set is unknown — would be the defect. This property is documented for the same reason as requires_interactive_owner_authentication: it is stated plainly rather than softened.
fail_closed_operating_property.statement: The guard is fail closed without exception. A guard configuration its own loader cannot accept therefore does not degrade into a weaker decision, it produces no decision at all, and every tool call of the guarded session is blocked — including reads. The session cannot repair this, because repairing it would require the very tools that are blocked. Only the owner restores it.

log_integrity_limit.rationale: The guard runs with the privileges of the guarded session. Any key the guard can read, the session can read too, so a signature would not establish provenance.
log_integrity_limit.statement: The protected protocol cannot be shortened or deleted by the normal session, but it can be enriched with further entries and is therefore forgeable in the forward direction.

not_protected_against: a hostile actor who already holds the owner's user rights
an actor who can obtain interactive owner authentication
replacement of the Claude Code application itself
modification of the operating system or its security subsystems
an actor with physical access to an unlocked machine
forged entries appended to the protected protocol

observation_area_limit.rationale: The guard runs with the privileges of the guarded session, so the session must be able to create a record for the guard to be able to write one at all.
observation_area_limit.statement: The observation area holds what the guard decided to ignore. It has exactly the integrity properties of the protected protocol: the session can add a record and cannot remove or rewrite one, so the area is forgeable in the forward direction and is never a provenance proof.
observation_area_limit.why_it_is_still_worth_having: A guard that removed the objects it decided to ignore would destroy the traces its own decision later has to be understood from. The record is a diagnosis, and a diagnosis that cannot be written changes no decision.

owner_authentication_boundary.mechanism: Every protected component is root owned; the session runs unprivileged and sudo requires a password.
owner_authentication_boundary.statement: The active guard chain cannot be changed by the normal running Claude Code session without an additional interactive owner action.

permitted_claims: Die aktive Guard-Kette kann von der normalen laufenden Claude-Code-Sitzung nicht ohne eine zusätzliche interaktive Eigentümerhandlung verändert werden.
The active guard chain cannot be changed by the normal running Claude Code session without an additional interactive owner action.
Der Guard ist ein Disziplinmechanismus, keine vollständige Sicherheitsgrenze gegen einen feindlichen Akteur mit Benutzerrechten.
The guard is a discipline mechanism, not a complete security boundary against a hostile actor holding user rights.
Das geschützte Protokoll ist nicht kürzbar und nicht löschbar, aber nach vorn anhängbar und damit fälschbar.
The protected protocol cannot be truncated or deleted by the session, but it can be appended to and is therefore forgeable forward.
prohibited_claims: gegen einen feindlichen lokalen Benutzer abgesichert
kann unter Benutzerrechten nicht deaktiviert werden
secured against a hostile local user
cannot be disabled under user rights
protected_against: mistakes and slips during ordinary tool use
forbidden commands issued through the normal tool path
process drift away from the agreed workflow
unintended history rewriting, in particular commit --amend
bypassing agreed workflows through ordinary tool usage
silent modification of the active rule set from inside the guarded session
purpose: A discipline mechanism. It keeps ordinary tool use inside the agreed workflow and makes a forbidden operation fail before it runs.

trust_roots.note: The application reads the policy configuration. Whoever can replace the application can ignore every hook. No component of this guard can close this.

trust_roots.location_class: root owned system path with a fully root owned ancestor chain
trust_roots.note: Verified mechanically on every guard start: owner, mode, symlink freedom, version and package hash.

trust_roots.location_class: root owned interpreter with a fully root owned ancestor chain
trust_roots.note: Both the declared and the actually running interpreter are checked, including stub and wrapper resolution.
